reading: Under the within-building permutation null the MH RR is centred at 0.999 (95% null interval 0.980-1.018), confirming the estimator is unbiased (no mechanical below-one pull). The observed 0.921 is below the null interval, so the slight reversal is a small but real within-building negative association, consistent with baseline composition (scheduling, finite capacity, mean-reversion) rather than propagation. The large positive pooled association vanishes within building either way.
